title: デビュー戦の後に・カワイイよ広がれ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan makes her debut without any trouble. Her social media is flooded with comments, and she enjoys all of the support. Her happiness doesn't last long, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On closer inspection, the majority of her fans aren't interested in her running. It's now clear to Curren Chan that she needs to increase the attention on her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Instead of deciding on a short-term race goal, Curren Chan decides to work on increasing her profile and name recognition while continuing to train.
